name: VPN Compromise Confirmed — Brute Force + Successful Login Same User
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "109006"
| filter xdm.source.user.username != null
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as vpn_fails,
       values(xdm.source.ipv4) as source_ips
       by xdm.source.user.username, _time
| filter vpn_fails >= 3
| join (
    datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "113039"
    | filter xdm.source.user.username != null
    | comp count() as vpn_logins by xdm.source.user.username
  ) as ok xdm.source.user.username = ok.xdm.source.user.username
| fields source_ips, xdm.source.user.username
description: Same user has VPN auth failures AND successful AnyConnect login.
alert_name: VPN Compromise Confirmed — Brute Force + Successful Login Same User
